title: potentilla aurea subsp. chrysocraspeda
intro: Potentilla aurea subsp. chrysocraspeda, commonly known as Golden Cinquefoil, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Golden Cinquefoil include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
